title: Positive-dimensional purity on an open immersion forces the coefficient unit to vanish
statement: Fix a prime ℓ, a field k of prime characteristic different from ℓ, and separated finite-type k-schemes X,Y [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let j:X→Y be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] and d a positive natural number. Write B_X for the condensed Qbar_ℓ coefficient ring, C_X=Mod(B_X), and 1_X for its regular module [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. If the underlying ambient derived object of the bounded-constructible exceptional inverse image of the coefficient unit, namely Rj^!(1_Y) [sk-def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek], is isomorphic to tateTwistDerived(X,ℓ,d)[2d] [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists], then 1_X is a zero object of C_X. This implication assumes no smoothness and makes no assertion about the choice of smoothTrace. It is also valid on an empty source.

proof.text: Use the existing boundedConstructibleUpperShriekUnitIso_padicAlgCl and the fully faithful ambient inclusion to identify Rj^!(1_Y) with the ambient derived tensor unit. This comparison is defined by conjugating the actual open-extension/pullback adjunction and using the monoidal pullback unit, not by smooth purity. Identify the derived tensor unit with the degree-zero single of the regular module via singleFunctorObjUnitIso. Compose with the assumed isomorphism.

By definition the Tate-derived object is its Tate module placed in degree zero. The canonical single-functor shift comparison identifies its 2d-shift with the single in degree -2d. Since d>0, this object has zero zeroth cohomology by DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isLE. Apply zeroth cohomology to the composite isomorphism from the previous step. The canonical singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso identifies the zeroth cohomology of the source with the regular module, proving it is zero. This uses no assertion that the Tate module is nonzero or invertible.

theorem isZero_unit_of_open_positive_purity
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)] {X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom]
    (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j.left] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (e : ((boundedConstructibleUpperShriek (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ j).obj
        (𝟙_ (Dᵇc(Y.left)⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧))).obj ≅
      (shiftFunctor _ (2 * d : ℤ)).obj (tateTwistDerived X.left ℓ d)) :
    IsZero (𝟙_ (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X.left)))
